findings.highlight: I'm starting to get bored of looking at her sleep…
findings.evidenceJa: いい加減、ずっとこいつの寝顔見てるのも……いや、飽きないけど、空腹に耐えられないのも本当で。
findings.explanation: Haruki starts to say he has had enough of watching her sleep, immediately corrects himself—no, he never gets tired of that—and admits only that he cannot bear the hunger. Todokanai TL cuts before the self-correction and states as fact the very feeling he retracts.
findings.japanese:
何しろこっちは起きてからもう５時間くらい経ってる。
いい加減、ずっとこいつの寝顔見てるのも……
いや、飽きないけど、空腹に耐えられないのも本当で。
findings.todokanai: In any case, it's been five hours since I woke up. I'm starting to get bored of looking at her sleep…

findings.highlight: she managed to love someone like me, and yet I…
findings.evidenceJa: だって、俺なんか、愛してた。なのに、あんな……
findings.explanation: In the middle of Kazusa's guilt over Setsuna, Haruki reflects that Setsuna loved even someone like him, and yet Kazusa or the two of them did what they did. Todokanai TL's added final 'I' reallocates the suspended reproach solely to Haruki and makes the sentence sound as though Setsuna merely 'managed' the feat of loving him.
findings.japanese:
だって、俺なんか、愛してた。
なのに、あんな……
findings.todokanai: After all, she managed to love someone like me, and yet I…

findings.highlight: This is a city of over ten million people in the heart of world-famous Tokyo!
findings.evidenceJa: そんな偶然が起こるとでも思ってるのか？
findings.explanation: Haruki's argument culminates in the rhetorical question 'Do you really think a coincidence like that could happen?' Todokanai TL drops it and leaves the quotation open, removing the exact claim Kazusa's anxious rebuttal answers.
findings.japanese:
「お前、ここをどこだと思ってる？
一千万都市だぞ？　花の都大東京だぞ？
そんな偶然が起こるとでも思ってるのか？」
findings.todokanai: "Just where do you think we are? This is a city of over ten million people in the heart of world-famous Tokyo!

findings.highlight: Don't try to rile me up, you bastard!
findings.evidenceJa: 今さら歯の浮くようなこと言うな馬鹿野郎
findings.explanation: Kazusa tells Haruki not to say such embarrassingly sappy or cheesy things now. Todokanai TL turns romantic embarrassment into an accusation that he is provoking her, breaking the setup for his reply about a hackneyed pickup line.
findings.japanese:
「お互い様だろ馬鹿野郎……
今さら歯の浮くようなこと言うな馬鹿野郎」
findings.todokanai: "I could say the same, you bastard…! Don't try to rile me up, you bastard!"

findings.evidenceJa: こんな陳腐な口説き文句に引っかかる馬鹿がいるからだ
findings.explanation: Haruki explicitly calls what he said a clichéd seduction or pickup line and says he uses it because one particular fool always falls for it. 'Provocations' removes the flirtation and makes Kazusa's answer—because it is you—lose its romantic force.
findings.japanese:
「そりゃ、いつまで経っても、
こんな陳腐な口説き文句に引っかかる馬鹿がいるからだ」
findings.todokanai: "I'm only doing it because a certain idiot keeps falling for the same old cliched provocations."

findings.highlight: No matter how many punches we have to take, and no matter how hard it is, we'll live in harmony with the outside world.
findings.evidenceJa:
どれだけ叩かれても、辛くても
外と触れ合って生きていくって……
findings.explanation: They resolve to live in contact with the outside world however much it attacks them or hurts; 'live in harmony' promises a concord the Japanese explicitly does not — The following line restores the expectation of pain.
findings.japanese:
どれだけ叩かれても、辛くても
外と触れ合って生きていくって……
findings.todokanai: No matter how many punches we have to take, and no matter how hard it is, we'll live in harmony with the outside world.

findings.highlight: I've decided to move forward with my life, even if it means I have to get hurt, whether because of myself or because of others.
findings.evidenceJa: 傷ついて、傷つけられて、これからも生きていくって、決めたんだから。
findings.explanation: The couple have decided to keep living while hurting others and being hurt themselves. Todokanai TL makes the decision Haruki's alone and converts the active moral admission that they will hurt people into the passive idea that his own actions may hurt him.
findings.japanese:
傷ついて、傷つけられて、
これからも生きていくって、決めたんだから。
findings.todokanai: I've decided to move forward with my life, even if it means I have to get hurt, whether because of myself or because of others.

findings.highlight: but it's not the only thing I gave her in this place.
findings.evidenceJa: それが三年前、俺がかずさに与えたもの。そしてここが、その中でも偽名以外を与えた場所。
findings.explanation: Haruki lists the comb, glasses, scarf, hat, and false name as what he gave Kazusa three years earlier, then identifies this mall as where he gave her all of those except the alias. Todokanai TL instead vaguely says he gave her additional unidentified things here and loses the precise physical callback.
findings.japanese:
それが三年前、俺がかずさに与えたもの。
そしてここが、その中でも偽名以外を与えた場所。
findings.todokanai: That's what I gave to Kazusa three years ago, but it's not the only thing I gave her in this place.

findings.highlight: only walking around the streets of Onjuku with nothing but our memories to guide us.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ記憶を頼りにさまよい、懐かしがり、はしゃぎ、そして笑いあった。
findings.explanation: The day is summarized not merely as wandering by memory, but as reminiscing, romping excitedly, and laughing together. Todokanai TL drops the entire sequence of recovered joy that makes their subsequent silence at the final location emotionally legible.
findings.japanese:
一度も電車やバスに乗らず、
ただ御宿の街を、ただ記憶を頼りにさまよい、
懐かしがり、はしゃぎ、そして笑いあった。
findings.todokanai: Not once getting on a bus or a train, only walking around the streets of Onjuku with nothing but our memories to guide us.

findings.highlight: I'd only figured that out much later after the fact.
findings.evidenceJa: いや、本当は二回目だったって、後から聞いたっけ。
findings.explanation: Haruki remembers being told afterward that this had actually been their second kiss—Kazusa kissed him first while he slept. Todokanai TL changes a later revelation from another person into something he independently figured out, obscuring the callback and who possessed the secret.
findings.japanese: いや、本当は二回目だったって、後から聞いたっけ。
findings.todokanai: Actually, that was the second time, though I'd only figured that out much later after the fact.
